TaskName: [MONTHLY][ALL] Verify next-month job schedules and time zone settings
Description: Prevents missed or mistimed loads and jobs in the coming month, including the close window, holiday calendar and daylight saving changes. FSSG: Verifies and maintains schedules. Finance: Provides and confirms the close calendar.
Instruction: Steps: 1) Export or list scheduled jobs and Data Integration schedules in each service and compare them with the Job Schedule Register: frequency, start time, end date, parameters and run-as account. 2) Confirm the time zone of every schedule and the daily maintenance window; check daylight saving transitions in the coming month for each time zone involved, including GB and EBS source extract times. 3) Confirm the sequence of upstream and downstream jobs still holds after any time zone shift (source extract before EPM load, load before calculation). 4) Confirm schedules are aligned with the Finance close calendar for the coming close. 5) Confirm next month's FSSG Task Manager schedules (daily and monthly) are created from the current templates. 6) Correct differences under the approved change process and update the Register. Expected result: All schedules match the Register and the close calendar; time zones and DST effects verified; next month's Task Manager schedules exist. Evidence: Schedule export or screenshots per service, Register reconciliation note, change references for corrections, Task Manager schedule names. If not successful: Difference found: correct under change control before month end; if the close window is affected, inform the Finance close lead. Close calendar not available: request it from the Finance close lead and record the dependency. A No answer does not by itself block completion: record the incident/SR number, the exception and the agreed next step in the task comments and attach the evidence before submitting.
QText1: Are all next-month job schedules, time zones and Task Manager schedules verified against the Job Schedule Register and the Finance close calendar?

TaskName: [MONTHLY][ALL] Assess Oracle monthly update impact on the close
Description: Confirms the Oracle monthly update does not break close-critical processes and does not land in the close window unassessed. FSSG: Performs regression testing and update risk assessment. Finance: Informed; may support business regression checks.
Instruction: Steps: 1) Review the Oracle readiness / What's New documents for the upcoming update for each service. 2) Confirm the Test and Production update dates for each service against the close calendar. 3) After the Test update, regression-test close-critical processes in Test: GB and EBS loads, FX load, consolidation, ARCS import, EDMCS export, Planning rules, Narrative Reporting refresh. 4) If a defect is found or the Production update conflicts with the close, raise an Oracle SR and, with FSSG Lead approval, evaluate deferring the update (EPM Automate skipUpdate, subject to Oracle policy). 5) Communicate the outcome to the FSSG Lead and the Finance close lead. Expected result: Regression tests passed in Test; no unresolved update issue affecting the close. Evidence: Regression test results, update dates, Oracle SR numbers, deferral decision if any. If not successful: Regression defect: Oracle SR, workaround plan and decision on deferral before the Production update date; inform the Finance close lead. A No answer does not by itself block completion: record the incident/SR number, the exception and the agreed next step in the task comments and attach the evidence before submitting.
QText1: Has the upcoming Oracle monthly update been regression-tested in the Test environment with no unresolved issues affecting the close?

TaskName: [MONTHLY][ALL] Verify integration credentials and SSO certificate validity
Description: Prevents close failures caused by expired passwords, tokens or certificates used by integrations, scripts and SSO. FSSG: Maintains the credential and certificate register. Finance: None.
Instruction: Steps: 1) List the service and integration accounts used by EPM Automate scripts, Data Integration connections (GB, EBS), Narrative Reporting data source connections and scheduled jobs. 2) Check password and token expiry dates and the validity of encrypted password files used by scripts. 3) Check expiry dates of the SAML/SSO signing certificates (identity provider and EPM identity domain) and any certificates used by integration agents. 4) For anything expiring within 60 days (recommended threshold), schedule renewal under change control outside the close window. Expected result: All credentials and certificates valid beyond the next close; renewals scheduled. Evidence: Credential and certificate register with expiry dates; change references for renewals. If not successful: Expired or expiring before the close: P2, renew immediately under emergency change and test the affected integration; inform the FSSG Lead. A No answer does not by itself block completion: record the incident/SR number, the exception and the agreed next step in the task comments and attach the evidence before submitting.
QText1: Are all integration credentials and SSO certificates valid beyond the next close cycle, with renewals scheduled for any expiring within 60 days?

TaskName: [MONTHLY][EDMCS] Verify metadata synchronization to target applications
Description: Confirms every approved metadata change for the period is in each target application before data loads and consolidation, preventing rejected loads and wrong roll-ups. FSSG: Runs and verifies synchronization. Finance: Data owners approve requests and confirm the metadata freeze.
Instruction: Steps: 1) Agree with the data owners the list of requests approved for the period and the metadata cut-off. 2) Confirm all those requests are Completed in EDMCS and none intended for the period are still in flight. 3) Run or verify the subscriptions and exports to FCCS, Planning and ARCS and the metadata import job in each target. 4) Confirm Refresh Database / cube refresh completed in FCCS and Planning after the import. 5) Compare EDMCS viewpoints with the target dimensions (EDMCS compare or member counts) for the changed dimensions. 6) Obtain data owner confirmation of the metadata freeze for the close. Expected result: All approved changes present in every target; imports and refreshes succeeded; metadata freeze confirmed. Evidence: Request list, export/import job IDs, refresh job IDs, comparison result, data owner confirmation. If not successful: Import or refresh failure: correct and re-run before data loads start; if not possible, P2 and inform the Finance close lead because loads may reject. Differences in comparison: investigate with the data owner before the freeze. A No answer does not by itself block completion: record the incident/SR number, the exception and the agreed next step in the task comments and attach the evidence before submitting.
QText1: Have all approved metadata changes for the period been synchronized from EDMCS to every target application without errors?

TaskName: [MONTHLY][ALL] Verify period mappings and substitution variables for the close
Description: Ensures loads, forms, rules and reports point to the close period that Finance confirmed, preventing loads into the wrong period. FSSG: Configures and verifies period settings. Finance: Confirms period values.
Instruction: Steps: 1) Obtain the close period values from the Finance close lead. 2) Confirm Data Integration period mappings (global, application and source mappings) exist for the close period for FCCS, Planning and ARCS integrations, including the GB and EBS source period names. 3) Update or verify substitution variables in FCCS and Planning (for example current period and year) per the Finance instruction. 4) Confirm Narrative Reporting points of view or variables used by report packages reference the close period. 5) Confirm scheduled jobs and scripts with period parameters use the correct period. Expected result: All period mappings, variables and job parameters set to the Finance-confirmed values. Evidence: Screenshots or exports of period mappings and variables; Finance period confirmation. If not successful: Missing mapping or wrong variable: correct before loads; if loads already ran into a wrong period, P2, stop further loads and inform the Finance close lead. A No answer does not by itself block completion: record the incident/SR number, the exception and the agreed next step in the task comments and attach the evidence before submitting.
QText1: Are period mappings and substitution variables set to the Finance-confirmed close period in all applicable applications?

TaskName: [MONTHLY][ARCS] Verify ARCS period and reconciliation creation readiness
Description: Confirms the ARCS period and reconciliations exist and are ready to receive balances, so preparers can start on time. FSSG: Performs technical period setup on Finance instruction. Finance: Decides period status; owns profiles; signs off reconciliations.
Instruction: Steps: 1) Confirm the period exists in ARCS and its status matches the Finance instruction. 2) Create or verify period reconciliations (EPM Automate createReconciliations or the UI) using the Finance-defined filter; compare the reconciliation count with the expected profile count. 3) Confirm ARCS data load definitions and period mappings for the period. 4) If ARCS multi-currency is used, confirm the ARCS rate load is planned (see FSSG_M007). Expected result: Period ready; reconciliation count matches expected profiles; load definitions ready. Evidence: Period status screenshot, reconciliation count, job IDs, Finance instruction reference. If not successful: Count difference: investigate profile changes with the Finance reconciliation owner before balances load. Job failure: correct, re-run, raise incident. A No answer does not by itself block completion: record the incident/SR number, the exception and the agreed next step in the task comments and attach the evidence before submitting.
QText1: Is the ARCS period set up with the expected number of reconciliations and ready to receive balances?

TaskName: [MONTHLY][FX] Verify month-end FX rates completeness and accuracy
Description: Confirms month-end average and closing rates are complete and identical to the approved source in every application before translation and consolidation. FSSG: Loads and technically compares rates. Finance: Owns and approves rates; confirms the comparison.
Instruction: Steps: 1) Obtain the approved month-end rate source (average and closing rates) from Finance/Treasury. 2) Confirm the rate loads to FCCS and, where used, Planning and ARCS ended with Success. 3) Completeness: confirm every currency pair in the Currency Pair Register is loaded for every rate type, the close period and every target application; no blank or zero rates. 4) Accuracy: compare 100% of loaded rates with the approved source (export vs source file); rates must match to the precision of the source. 5) Confirm the rate convention (direct/indirect, triangulation currency) matches the application configuration. 6) Send the comparison result to the Finance rate owner for confirmation. Expected result: 100% of required pairs and rate types loaded in every application and matching the source. Evidence: Approved source reference, load job IDs, comparison output per application, Finance confirmation. If not successful: Missing or mismatched rates: reload from the approved source and repeat the comparison before consolidation; if consolidation already ran, inform the Finance close lead that translation must be re-run. FSSG never keys or changes rate values without written Finance approval. A No answer does not by itself block completion: record the incident/SR number, the exception and the agreed next step in the task comments and attach the evidence before submitting.
QText1: Are month-end average and closing FX rates loaded for every required currency pair and application, and do they fully match the approved source?

Description: Gives the Finance close lead one documented technical go/no-go status before the close starts. FSSG: Prepares and communicates the readiness status. Finance: Finance close lead acknowledges and decides on close start.
Instruction: Steps: 1) Review the results of FSSG_M001 to FSSG_M007 and any open exceptions. 2) Review open P1/P2 incidents and Oracle SRs that could affect the close. 3) Confirm no Oracle update or maintenance falls in the close window (FSSG_M002). 4) Confirm the change freeze for the close window with change management and the FSSG support coverage for close days. 5) Send the status (Ready / Ready with exceptions / Not ready) with exceptions to the Finance close lead and record the acknowledgement. Expected result: Readiness status communicated and acknowledged; no open P1/P2 affecting the close. Evidence: Readiness status message, exception list, Finance acknowledgement. If not successful: Not ready: agree mitigation and timing with the Finance close lead and the FSSG Lead; record the decision. The task is completed once the status is communicated. A No answer does not by itself block completion: record the incident/SR number, the exception and the agreed next step in the task comments and attach the evidence before submitting.
QText1: Are all pre-close technical checks complete with no open P1/P2 incident affecting the close?

Description: Provides Finance with technical assurance that month-end GB data was loaded completely for the close period. FSSG: Technical completeness of the load. Finance: Validates balances (financial validation is a Finance task).
Instruction: Steps: 1) Confirm with Finance whether the load is the final load (source period closed) or an agreed interim load. 2) Confirm each month-end GB integration ended with Success for the close period. 3) Reconcile source record counts and control totals (as provided by the GB interface) with loaded values per integration. 4) Confirm zero unresolved rejected or unmapped records. 5) Inform Finance that data is available for financial validation. Expected result: Month-end GB loads complete; counts and control totals reconcile; no unresolved rejections. Evidence: Process IDs, counts and control totals source vs target, rejection report, notification. If not successful: As FSSG_D003; during the close window treat as P2 and agree re-load timing with the Finance close lead. A No answer does not by itself block completion: record the incident/SR number, the exception and the agreed next step in the task comments and attach the evidence before submitting.
QText1: Were all month-end GB loads completed for the close period with reconciled counts and control totals and no unresolved rejections?

TaskName: [MONTHLY][EBS] Verify month-end Oracle EBS loads completeness
Description: Provides Finance with technical assurance that month-end EBS data was loaded completely for the close period. FSSG: Technical completeness of the load. Finance: Closes the EBS period; validates balances.
Instruction: Steps: 1) Confirm with Finance whether the EBS GL period is closed (final load) or the load is an agreed interim load. 2) Confirm each month-end EBS integration ended with Success for the close period. 3) Reconcile source record counts and control totals (for example EBS trial balance totals provided by Finance or the EBS team) with loaded values. 4) Confirm zero unresolved rejected or unmapped records. 5) Inform Finance that data is available for financial validation. Expected result: Month-end EBS loads complete; counts and control totals reconcile; no unresolved rejections. Evidence: Process IDs, counts and control totals source vs target, rejection report, notification. If not successful: As FSSG_D004; during the close window treat as P2 and agree re-load timing with the Finance close lead. A No answer does not by itself block completion: record the incident/SR number, the exception and the agreed next step in the task comments and attach the evidence before submitting.
QText1: Were all month-end Oracle EBS loads completed for the close period with reconciled counts and control totals and no unresolved rejections?

TaskName: [MONTHLY][FCCS] Verify consolidation and translation job execution
Description: Confirms consolidation, translation and related rules ran without technical errors, so Finance reviews results produced by a complete technical run. FSSG: Technical execution and job health. Finance: Runs/approves consolidation; validates results, journals and data status.
Instruction: Steps: 1) Confirm month-end loads and FX rates are complete before consolidation is run. 2) Run (where FSSG runs scheduled jobs) or monitor consolidation, translation and related business rule jobs per the agreed close process. 3) Confirm each job ended with Success within expected duration; review logs for errors and warnings. 4) List entities left Impacted or not consolidated because of a technical failure and send the list to Finance. Expected result: All consolidation-related jobs succeeded; no entity left unconsolidated by a technical error. Evidence: Job IDs, status, duration, log extracts, list of affected entities (if any). If not successful: Raise a P2 incident with the log; check recent metadata or rule changes; re-run only with agreement of the Finance close lead; open an Oracle SR for product errors or severe performance degradation. A No answer does not by itself block completion: record the incident/SR number, the exception and the agreed next step in the task comments and attach the evidence before submitting.
QText1: Did all FCCS consolidation, translation and related business rule jobs for the period complete without technical errors?

TaskName: [MONTHLY][ARCS] Verify ARCS period balance load for reconciliations
Description: Confirms reconciliations received complete period balances so preparers can work. FSSG: Technical load completeness. Finance: Prepares, reviews and signs off reconciliations.
Instruction: Steps: 1) Confirm the ARCS balance imports (source system and subsystem) for the period ended with Success. 2) Compare the number of reconciliations with loaded balances against the reconciliations created in FSSG_M006. 3) Review import errors and balances not assigned to a profile. 4) Confirm auto-reconciliation and, if used, Transaction Matching period jobs ran. 5) Inform the Finance reconciliation owner that balances are available. Expected result: All period balances loaded; no unresolved import errors; Finance informed. Evidence: Job IDs, counts, error report, notification. If not successful: Technical failure: correct and re-load, P2 during close. Balances without a profile: send to the Finance reconciliation owner. A No answer does not by itself block completion: record the incident/SR number, the exception and the agreed next step in the task comments and attach the evidence before submitting.
QText1: Were ARCS period balances imported successfully for all reconciliations with no unresolved import errors?

TaskName: [MONTHLY][Planning] Verify Planning actuals load, calculations and data maps
Description: Confirms Planning received the period actuals and that related calculations and data movements ran without technical errors. FSSG: Technical execution and completeness. Finance: FP&A validates actuals and forecast impact.
Instruction: Steps: 1) Confirm the actuals load to Planning (from FCCS, GB or EBS per configuration) ended with Success for the close period; reconcile counts and control totals with the source. 2) Confirm Refresh Database ran if metadata changed this period (FSSG_M004). 3) Confirm aggregation and actuals-related business rules ran successfully. 4) Confirm data maps/Smart Push to reporting cubes completed. 5) Inform FP&A that actuals are available. Expected result: Actuals loaded and reconciled; calculations and data maps succeeded. Evidence: Job IDs, counts/control totals, rule and data map job status, notification. If not successful: Correct and re-run per runbook; raise an incident; inform FP&A of any delay. A No answer does not by itself block completion: record the incident/SR number, the exception and the agreed next step in the task comments and attach the evidence before submitting.
QText1: Did the Planning actuals load, calculations and data maps for the period complete successfully with reconciled control totals?

TaskName: [MONTHLY][Narrative Reporting] Verify report package refresh and distribution
Description: Confirms report packages refresh from the correct sources and period and that the Finance-approved distribution was delivered. FSSG: Technical refresh and distribution. Finance: Approves report content and releases distribution.
Instruction: Steps: 1) Confirm data source connections to FCCS and Planning are valid and point to Production. 2) Confirm report package POVs/variables reference the close period (FSSG_M005). 3) Confirm report and doclet refresh completed without errors. 4) After Finance approves content, run or verify bursting/distribution to the approved distribution list and confirm delivery. Expected result: Refresh succeeded for the correct period; approved distribution delivered. Evidence: Refresh job status, package names, distribution log, Finance release reference. If not successful: Refresh error: fix connection or POV and re-refresh; raise an incident. Never distribute before Finance release. A No answer does not by itself block completion: record the incident/SR number, the exception and the agreed next step in the task comments and attach the evidence before submitting.
QText1: Did the report package refresh and the Finance-approved distribution complete without technical errors?

TaskName: [MONTHLY][ALL] Verify period lock and roll schedules forward
Description: Ensures no scheduled load or script writes into a locked period and that schedules point to the next period. FSSG: Rolls schedules forward; verifies technical lock effect. Finance: Locks the period.
Instruction: Steps: 1) Obtain Finance confirmation that the period is locked/closed in FCCS and ARCS (Finance performs or instructs locking). 2) Review Data Integration schedules and scripts with period parameters and confirm none target the locked period. 3) Roll period parameters and substitution variables forward per the Finance instruction. 4) Update the Job Schedule Register. Expected result: No scheduled load targets the locked period; schedules point to the next period. Evidence: Finance lock confirmation, list of updated schedules/scripts, Register update. If not successful: Load into a locked period attempted or found: stop the schedule, raise an incident and inform the Finance close lead. A No answer does not by itself block completion: record the incident/SR number, the exception and the agreed next step in the task comments and attach the evidence before submitting.
QText1: Are all scheduled loads and scripts rolled forward so that none target the locked period?

Description: Keeps a recoverable, auditable copy of each application as at period close beyond Oracle's own backup retention. FSSG: Performs the archive. Finance: None.
Instruction: Steps: 1) After the period lock, download the latest Artifact Snapshot (or a snapshot created after the lock) for each production service. 2) Store it in the approved secure repository with the period in the file name. 3) Confirm file size and date are plausible and the retention rule is applied. Expected result: One post-close snapshot per service stored in the approved repository. Evidence: Repository path, file names, sizes and dates. If not successful: Download failure: retry, raise an incident if persistent; record the gap. A No answer does not by itself block completion: record the incident/SR number, the exception and the agreed next step in the task comments and attach the evidence before submitting.
QText1: Has a post-close snapshot of every production service been archived in the approved repository?

TaskName: [MONTHLY][ALL] Compile month-end technical evidence and exception summary
Description: Provides an auditable record of the month-end technical controls and their exceptions. FSSG: Compiles the evidence pack. Finance: Receives the summary; acknowledges carried-forward exceptions.
Instruction: Steps: 1) Export or reference the completed FSSG Task Manager tasks with answers, comments and attachments for the period. 2) List all incidents and Oracle SRs raised in the period with status and resolution. 3) Confirm every exception has an incident and a resolution or an agreed carry-forward. 4) Summarise recurring issues and improvement actions. 5) Send the summary to the FSSG Lead and the Finance close lead and store it in the evidence repository. Expected result: Evidence pack complete; every exception linked and resolved or carried forward. Evidence: Evidence pack location and distribution reference. If not successful: Missing evidence: obtain it from the task assignee before the pack is issued. A No answer does not by itself block completion: record the incident/SR number, the exception and the agreed next step in the task comments and attach the evidence before submitting.
QText1: Has the month-end evidence pack been compiled with every exception linked to an incident and its resolution or agreed carry-forward?

TaskName: [MONTHLY][ALL] Review EPM user access, privileged roles and leavers
Description: Detects inappropriate, privileged or orphaned access and obtains application owner certification. FSSG: Produces reports and remediates approved changes. Finance: Application owners certify access.
Instruction: Steps: 1) Generate the role assignment and user/group reports for each service (Access Control or EPM Automate roleAssignmentReport). 2) Compare Service Administrator and other privileged assignments with the approved list. 3) Identify leavers and movers by comparing with the identity provider/HR source. 4) Review FSSG support, service and emergency accounts and access granted during the month. 5) Send exceptions to the application owners for approval or removal; remediate through approved requests. Expected result: All exceptions approved or remediated; application owners certified access. Evidence: Reports per service, exception list, owner approvals, remediation request numbers. If not successful: Unapproved privileged access: remove under the security procedure and inform IT Security; unresolved exceptions are tracked as incidents. A No answer does not by itself block completion: record the incident/SR number, the exception and the agreed next step in the task comments and attach the evidence before submitting.
QText1: Has the monthly access review been completed with all exceptions approved or remediated by the application owners?
